items.prompt: Why keep tail 4 rather than tail 7 for two subsequences of the same length?

options.text: It guarantees the original 4 appears before every other input item.
options.why: The dominance argument is about future values after this prefix, not all earlier indexes.

options.text: Every future value must exceed 7 anyway.
options.why: Future values are unrestricted within the input domain.

options.text: It proves the two subsequences have identical earlier elements.
Any future extension of 7 also extends 4.
options.why: A smaller same-length tail has at least the extension opportunities of a larger one.

items.explanation: A smaller same-length tail has at least the extension opportunities of a larger one.
